info.title: NestJS Backend → Amadeus8 AC Service API
info.description:
Complete API surface of the Amadeus8 C# service. Documents all endpoints available for the NestJS backend (and other consumers) to call.

Changes in v4.0.0:
- Added PUT /api/equipment-status (EquipmentStatusController).
- Added POST /api/amadeus/import/access (AmadeusImportController).
- Added GET /api/Status, /api/Status/listener, /api/Status/sync (StatusController).
- Added GET /api/Health, /api/Health/live, /api/Health/ready (HealthController).
- Added GET /api/Events/recent, /api/Events/{id} (EventsController).
- Added GET /api/AccessGroups, /api/AccessGroups/{amadeusUid} (AccessGroupsController).
- Added GET /api/SecurityGroups, /api/SecurityGroups/{amadeusUid} (SecurityGroupsController).
- Added POST /api/Sync/* — 8 trigger routes (SyncController). These trigger C#→NestJS sync; NestJS does NOT call them directly.
- Marked endpoints not currently called from ac-api.service.ts with ⚠️.

v3.0.0 notes (retained):
- POST /api/import/access-levels is ASYNC (returns 202 + jobId).
- ImportJobStatusResponse includes accessLevelPayload field for access-level import jobs.
- CardholderCreateDto added cardholderTypeUid and licensePlate fields.
- CardholderUpdateDto added licensePlate field.
- NestJS backend still sends PUT for updateCardholder; C# accepts PATCH. Verb mismatch persists.
- Removed query params from GET /api/cardholders — C# controller does not bind them.

v2.0.0 notes (retained):
- POST /api/import returns { jobId } (async). Full payload retrieved by polling.
- GET /api/import/status/{jobId} for polling.
- Cardholder update is PATCH on C# side.
- POST /api/cardholders/visitors (create visitor).
- DELETE /api/cardholders/visitors/{amadeusUid} (delete visitor).
- POST /api/cardholders/{amadeusUid}/archive.
- Batch endpoints flagged as NOT YET IMPLEMENTED in C# service.

post.description: Triggers a background device import (controllers/doors/extensions with IOs). Returns immediately with a jobId. Poll GET /api/import/status/{jobId} for progress and the final ImportCallbackPayload.

202.description: Job accepted — returns jobId for polling

get.description: Returns the current state of a device or access-level import job. On completion, includes the full ImportCallbackPayload (device import) or AccessLevelCallbackPayload (access-level import). On failure, includes errorMessage.

200.description: Job status (Pending, importing, Completed, or Failed)

post.description: Triggers a background access-level import from Amadeus OData. Returns immediately with a jobId. Poll GET /api/import/status/{jobId} for progress; the completed status includes accessLevelPayload.

get.description: Returns all cardholders. Note: NestJS sends query params (search, accessLevelName, isVisitor, active, page, limit) but the C# controller GetAll action does NOT bind or process them — they are ignored.

502.description: Failed to create in Amadeus OData

EmptyRequestBody.title: EmptyRequestBody
EmptyRequestBody.description: Endpoint takes no input — request body must be an empty JSON object. Extra properties are rejected.

jobId.description: Unique job identifier. Use to poll GET /api/import/status/{jobId}.

ImportJobStatusResponse.title: ImportJobStatusResponse
ImportJobStatusResponse.description: Returned by GET /api/import/status/{jobId}. For device imports: when status is 'Completed', payload is populated. For access-level imports: when status is 'Completed', accessLevelPayload is populated. When status is 'Failed', errorMessage is set.

payload.description: Populated on completion of device import jobs

accessLevelPayload.description: Populated on completion of access-level import jobs
